name: web-chat-style-faq-bubbles-with-black-answer-and-emoji-reactions
title: FAQ shown as iMessage-like bubbles: grey questions with plus icons, an open one with a black answer bubble, and emoji reactions
whatItIs: A white frame with a small timestamp 'Every day, 9:01 AM' and a list of light grey question bubbles with plus icons; the open one is darker grey with a minus and a red heart reaction and is answered by a black right-aligned bubble 'The internet doesn't close. It's available 24/7.', while another has a star reaction.
whatItMeans: Playful and human; framing an FAQ as a conversation makes it feel friendly.
techniques: Answer in a black bubble on the other side.
Use plus and minus to toggle.

vocabulary.definition: An FAQ presented as a message thread.
An emoji attached to a bubble corner.
A dark bubble carrying the reply.
A small time label above a thread.
